name: Autohive
notes: No-code platform for teams to build and run AI agents (from a marketplace or an Agent Creator prompt), with 140+ integrations, scheduled jobs, webhooks and skills; runs as a web app with iOS and Android apps. Requested via the form (issue #207).
tagline: Your team is losing 10 hours every week to work AI should be doing.

access.price: Free (350K credits/mo); Lite $20/mo; Starter $99/mo; Team $499/mo; Enterprise custom (USD, unlimited seats)
